app.title: Sigrun
app.tagline: Your SSH keys and connections, in one place.

uninitialized.title: Create your vault
uninitialized.body: Choose a passphrase to encrypt your keys. It cannot be recovered if you forget it.

locked.title: Vault locked
locked.body: Enter your passphrase to unlock your keys and connections.

connections.title: Connections
connections.empty: No connections yet. Add one to get started.
connections.label: Label
connections.passwordHint: The server's password, stored encrypted in Sigrun's vault. This is not your vault passphrase.
connections.removeConfirm: Remove this connection? This cannot be undone.

keys.title: Keys
keys.empty: No keys yet. Generate or import one.
keys.name: Name
keys.removeConfirm: Remove this key? This cannot be undone.

provision.title: Install SSH key
provision.body: Install one of your vault or disk keys on this server using its password.
provision.lockoutWarning: This will lock you out if key login fails. Make sure you can log in with a key first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.openInUnavailable: This terminal cannot open a tab.

trust.title: Trust this host?
trust.body: This is the first time you connect to this host. Verify the fingerprint before continuing.
trust.mismatch: Warning: the host fingerprint has changed. This could be a man-in-the-middle attack.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Sigrun keeps your SSH keys and connections in one place. The name comes from Sigrún: sigr means victory and rún means secret — victory over key chaos.

quickStart.title: Quick start
quickStart.vault: Create or unlock the vault with your passphrase.
quickStart.key: Import a key from disk, or generate a new one.
quickStart.connection: Add a connection: label, host, user, and port.
quickStart.connect: Connect — Sigrun opens your terminal running ssh.
quickStart.provision: On a server that only accepts passwords, use “Install SSH key…” to install a key from your vault using the server's password.

groups.title: Connections and groups
groups.nesting: Groups nest with “/”. A connection in PVE/Folder 1 shows under Folder 1 inside PVE.
groups.tray: Left-click the tray icon: with the vault locked it opens the window so you can unlock; with the vault unlocked it opens the connection menu, grouped the same way.

keys.title: Keys
keys.vault: Vault-backed keys live encrypted in Sigrun and are served by its SSH agent — no key file on disk.
keys.disk: Disk-backed keys stay where they are. Sigrun passes -i <path> to ssh and leaves your ~/.ssh untouched.

settings.title: Settings
settings.summary: Theme and appearance, language, the terminal to launch, where a connect opens, auto-lock after idle, and start minimized to the tray.

host.desc: Run the host in the foreground.

connectionsConnect.desc: Open a connection in the terminal.

data.title: Where data lives
data.dir: Your data lives in the per-user data directory: ~/Library/Application Support/Sigrun on macOS, ~/.local/share/sigrun on Linux, and %APPDATA%\Sigrun on Windows.
